column2: creature in addition to being a land
column3: Contradicts the card's Oracle text in part (copying error, a log kind decided by the user Nov 5; policy ruling-contradicting-oracle-gives-way, decided by the user Nov 5; small-fixes-1): the 2014-02-01 ruling has Heroes' Podium count itself only if some other effect causes it to be a creature 'in addition to being a land', but Heroes' Podium is a Legendary Artifact (Born of the Gods, its only set) and nothing in its text makes it a land; by its Oracle text ('Each legendary creature you control gets +1/+1 for each other legendary creature you control.') it counts itself, and gets the bonus, whenever it's a legendary creature (an artifact creature under March of the Machines). Origin: the card's own note in the Born of the Gods Release Notes (Matt Tabak, published 2014-01-22; ormos mirror, Wayback capture 2022-01-23) ends 'It won't count itself.', without the clause; no ruling in the data has the clause's words. The rest of the ruling (it counts only legendary creatures; it counts itself, and gets the bonus, when another effect makes it a creature) agrees with the card and stays cited (tests/rulings/r_p168_legends.rs). Logged in docs/RULING_DISCREPANCIES.md.
